title: A little smaller than I expected, but looks good enough.
text: A little smaller than I expected, but looks good enough.. Thought it was bigger, my bad cause it ended up being quite small. I kinda had hoped for something a big larger, like the one I have already at home and it's very useful so I wanted something similar to it. I suppose I could use this one for other things instead.
